FutureSolutionsSection.description1: Our close collaboration with our joint venture, the law firm Maîtres du Recouvrement, allows us to offer an unmatched integrated solution.

FutureSolutionsSection.description2_1: Those of debtor-clients whose communication must be maintained or restored, those of agreements to be structured and relationships to be preserved. By recognizing the importance of each situation and the legal framework governing the creditor-debtor relationship - and vice versa - we deploy tailored strategies that preserve and enhance the relationship with your clients, while ensuring optimal recovery.
FutureSolutionsSection.description2_2: CommUnité is the strategic ally of optimal, economical, and secure financial management, supported by top-tier legal expertise.
FutureSolutionsSection.description3: To optimize the management of client accounts by combining legal supervision, receivables management, bad debt recovery, and accounting solutions, all enhanced by cutting-edge tools.

OurCommitment.heroTitle: At CommUnite, we are committed to providing you with accounts receivable management solutions based on six essential pillars:
OurCommitment.description1: The protection of your data is our top priority. Our solutions are ISO 27001 and SOC 2 Type II certified, ensuring the highest standards of information security and data control. You can trust our ability to handle your sensitive information with the utmost care.
OurCommitment.description2: Our automated systems are designed to optimize the management of your receivables, facilitating communication with your clients and simplifying the payment process. This automation ensures unmatched accuracy and optimal results, allowing you to recover your receivables quickly and without hassle.
OurCommitment.description3: We believe in open and clear communication with our clients. Our managers are always available to collaborate with your teams, ensuring smooth and effective cooperation. We provide detailed reports and regular updates, guaranteeing total transparency and flawless accounting accuracy, so you always have a clear view of your receivables’ status.
OurCommitment.description4: We understand that every business has unique needs. That’s why we offer personalized integration services, tailored to your company's operations and IT systems. Our teams support you every step of the way, from implementation to optimization, so that our solutions seamlessly integrate with your existing processes without disrupting your activities.
OurCommitment.description5: Backed by specialized lawyers, our management solutions are rigorously tested to ensure absolute reliability and impeccable legal compliance. You can rely on us to manage your receivables with exemplary professionalism.
OurCommitment.description6: Our solutions benefit from the continuous expertise of our lawyers and receivables management specialists. Every action taken is optimized, legally sound, and ethically impeccable. We provide full legal support to secure your financial operations and protect your interests at every step.
OurCommitment.lastBoxText: With CommUnité, you benefit from receivables management solutions that not only protect your financial interests but also transform your accounts receivable management into a major asset. We help you create an environment where proactive management of your receivables becomes a driver of sustainable growth and strengthened business relationships.

ServicePage.title: At CommUnité, we offer a full range of services designed to meet the specific needs of each business.
ServicePage.textTitle: Thanks to our diverse expertise, innovative approach, and guaranteed legal support, we help our clients improve their receivables, optimize their customer relationships, and secure their cash flow.
ServicePage.reviewsText3: Improve your performance and reach new heights
ServicePage.cardText1: Maximize the management of your receivables at minimal cost with our fully or partially automated services. Taking into account the quality of available information and payment deadlines for receivables, we offer customized solutions tailored to your needs. Maintain healthy cash flow with our proactive management of accounts under 90 days. We ensure that your invoices are paid on time while maintaining harmonious relationships with your clients.
ServicePage.cardText2: Secure the recovery of your receivables by quickly identifying those at the highest risk of delay and intervening appropriately at the right time. Clients who subscribe to our receivables management services benefit from a preferential rate for recovery, provided by our joint venture, the law firm Maîtres du Recouvrement. Our balanced approach combines efficiency, effectiveness, and respectability, allowing you to recover your receivables while maintaining positive professional relationships with your debtors.
ServicePage.cardTitle3: 'Lex dura, sed lex' – The law is harsh, but it is the law. To ensure that the claims assigned by our clients are flawless from a legal standpoint, we ensure their perfect legal compliance.
ServicePage.cardText3: Moreover, we provide advice on debt recovery practices from a legal framework perspective. We guide you on what to say, when to say it, and how to say it, while scrupulously respecting legal obligations and applicable regulations, so that recovery operations are flawless.
ServicePage.cardIncludeTitle1: The development of a recovery policy
ServicePage.cardIncludeTitle2: The review and drafting of contracts

CollectionServicesPage.tabTitle4: The review and drafting of contracts
CollectionServicesPage.tab1Descr1: Diligent follow-up is the primary lever for debt recovery. *Our automated solutions allow you to rigorously track all outstanding obligations by sending systematic reminders and ensuring constant communication with your debtors.* With these tools, you can maximize your chances of recovery while reducing the time spent on manual accounts receivable management.
CollectionServicesPage.tab1Descr2: *We offer our clients complete flexibility in managing their receivables.* You can entrust us with full management, freeing up your time and relieving you of administrative worries. Alternatively, you can choose our online, custom software, designed to perfectly fit your specific needs and optimize your internal management into a simple and intuitive process.
CollectionServicesPage.tab1Descr3: *This service provides access to a Client Portal that offers detailed reports and real-time tracking of cases, as well as interventions made with your debtor clients.* Additionally, our software is highly secure and certified SOC 2 Type 2, the benchmark for data security and privacy.
CollectionServicesPage.tab2Descr1: *Masters of Recovery* is a law firm specialized in amicable and judicial debt recovery. Our team of professionals is led by lawyers and recovery experts.
CollectionServicesPage.tab2Descr2: *When a receivable entrusted to CommUnite reaches a predefined delay threshold (generally 90 days), the case is immediately transferred to our joint venture, the law firm Masters of Recovery, which takes charge of the case and deploys more legally binding recovery measures.* The case is then evaluated according to assessment metrics that assign it a Recovery Probability Index (RPI). This proven and intuitive formula combines various data points that inform about the borrower's capacity and solvency, enabling tailored and contextual management of receivables while ensuring unmatched results.
CollectionServicesPage.tab2Descr3: At Masters of Recovery, we prioritize communication focused on collaboration and constructive problem-solving. *Our exchanges aim to encourage dialogue and value the participants, with the goal of finding mutually beneficial solutions.* Concerned about the interests of our creditor clients, we promote mediation with the debtor party but do not hesitate to resort to coercive judicial measures when dialogue proves unsuccessful or impossible. Creditors can assign their unpaid debts directly to the law firm Masters of Recovery. However, those who assign them first to CommUnite benefit from a discount.
CollectionServicesPage.tab2Descr4: By choosing CommUnite, you benefit from comprehensive, personalized, and secure debt management, supported by innovative technologies and specialized legal expertise, ensuring optimal results, complete transparency, and support for sustainable growth.
CollectionServicesPage.tab3Descr1: The development of a well-defined recovery policy is essential not only for maintaining good financial health within a company but also for coordinating the various resources assigned to this task. This service includes one or all of the following:
CollectionServicesPage.tab3SubDescr1: Drafting or revising the existing policy and practices. Identifying gaps and proposing improvements.
CollectionServicesPage.tab3SubDescr2: Analyze the company's current debt recovery practices, identify weaknesses, and opportunities for improvement.
CollectionServicesPage.tab3SubDescr3: Set clear and realistic deadlines for invoice payment.
CollectionServicesPage.tab3SubDescr4: Implement standardized processes for managing receivables, including follow-up steps and actions to take in case of non-payment.
CollectionServicesPage.tab3SubDescr5: Training internal teams on the new recovery procedures to ensure effective implementation. Coordination with external providers, if applicable.
CollectionServicesPage.tab3SubDescr6: Development or integration of receivables management software for real-time tracking of payments and follow-ups, along with regular monitoring for adjustments based on results achieved.
CollectionServicesPage.tab3Descr2: By choosing CommUnite, you benefit from comprehensive, personalized, and secure debt management, supported by innovative technologies and specialized legal expertise, ensuring optimal results, complete transparency, and support for sustainable growth.
CollectionServicesPage.tab4Descr1: *Contracts are the fundamental cornerstone of business relationships, establishing a clear and secure framework for commitments between business partners.* They define not only the rights and obligations of each party but also ensure the protection of the company's interests in case of disputes or payment defaults. Rigorous contract management helps prevent risks and secure transactions, while strengthening trust and transparency in your collaborations.
CollectionServicesPage.tab4SubDescr2: Examine current contracts to ensure they adequately protect the company's interests and comply with applicable laws.
CollectionServicesPage.tab4SubDescr3: Create tailored contracts that cover all essential aspects, including the obligations of the parties, payment terms, penalties, interest, guarantees, and required mentions for reporting a debt to credit bureaus, etc.
CollectionServicesPage.tab4SubDescr4: Assist in negotiating contractual terms with clients or partners to ensure that agreements are favorable and fair.
CollectionServicesPage.tab4SubDescr5: Ensure that the terms are written clearly to avoid any ambiguity that could lead to future conflicts.
CollectionServicesPage.tab4Descr2: By choosing CommUnite, you benefit from comprehensive, personalized, and secure debt management, supported by innovative technologies and specialized legal expertise, ensuring optimal results, complete transparency, and support for sustainable growth.
CollectionServicesPage.tab5Descr1: The establishment of recovery scripts is an essential element of a well-defined recovery policy. Our scripts are designed to guide clients towards settling their debts while maintaining a positive relationship with your company, thus ensuring the preservation of long-term business relationships. They provide clear and consistent guidelines for every interaction with your clients, ensuring that communications remain professional, uniform, and effective.
CollectionServicesPage.tab5SubDescr2: Develop detailed scripts for payment reminders. Our scripts include polite greetings, clear explanations, reasons for the call, open-ended questions to understand the client's situation, and proposed payment solutions.
CollectionServicesPage.tab5SubDescr3: Similar to call scripts, written scripts support and complement your communications at each stage of recovery. They are customizable while including key elements such as the amount due, the due date, and payment options, ensuring clear and consistent communication.
CollectionServicesPage.tab5SubDescr5: Friendly and informative scripts for initial communications, reminding the client of the payment deadline and providing information on payment methods.
CollectionServicesPage.tab5SubDescr6: Firmer scripts, emphasizing the importance of maintaining the business relationship by inviting clients to contact you in case of financial difficulty.
CollectionServicesPage.tab5SubDescr7: Clear and determined scripts for last contact attempts, informing the client of imminent subsequent actions and penalties related to the delay.
CollectionServicesPage.tab5SubDescr9: Organize training sessions where staff can practice using the scripts through role-playing. This allows employees to become familiar with the scripts and learn how to respond to various client reactions.
CollectionServicesPage.tab5SubDescr10: Teach employees how to adapt the scripts based on the client's reaction while remaining within the established guidelines. This flexibility allows for effective management of varied and complex situations.
CollectionServicesPage.tab5SubDescr11: Integrate pre-established responses to common client objections, helping agents remain professional and advance the conversation.
CollectionServicesPage.tab5SubDescr12: Guidelines on situations where it is necessary to escalate a case, for example, to a supervisor, legal department, or management, based on the client's reaction or the amount overdue.
CollectionServicesPage.tab5SubDescr14: Establish a process for regular script review to ensure they remain relevant and effective. Feedback from recovery teams can be used to adjust and improve the scripts.
CollectionServicesPage.tab5SubDescr15: Ensure that the scripts comply with applicable laws and regulations, respecting client rights while protecting the company's interests.
CollectionServicesPage.tab5Descr3: By choosing CommUnite, you benefit from comprehensive, personalized, and secure debt management, supported by innovative technologies and specialized legal expertise, ensuring optimal results, complete transparency, and support for sustainable growth.
CollectionServicesPage.tab6Descr1: At CommUnite, a law firm specialized in innovative receivables management, we understand the importance of protecting your business legally. In this regard, we can provide a comprehensive legal support service designed to ensure the security and compliance of your activities. This service aims to offer complete legal assistance to protect your business in the following areas
CollectionServicesPage.tab6SubDescr1: We provide legal recommendations tailored to the specific needs of your business, whether for debt management, contract drafting, or regulatory compliance.
CollectionServicesPage.tab6SubDescr2: We assist you in managing conflicts with your clients or partners, including legal representation if necessary, to defend your interests professionally.
CollectionServicesPage.tab6SubDescr3: We keep you informed of legislative developments that may affect your activities, and we adjust your practices accordingly to minimize legal risks.
CollectionServicesPage.tab6SubDescr4: We help you identify and mitigate potential legal risks by implementing strategies to avoid conflicts and disputes.
CollectionServicesPage.tab6Descr2: By choosing CommUnite, you benefit from comprehensive, personalized, and secure debt management, supported by innovative technologies and specialized legal expertise, ensuring optimal results, complete transparency, and support for sustainable growth.

AdvantagesPage.heroTitle: By choosing CommUnite, you benefit from a comprehensive range of advantages that go beyond simple receivables management.
AdvantagesPage.advantagesItemContent1: As a law firm specializing in receivables management, we combine legal expertise and collection skills to offer you complete solutions tailored to your needs.
AdvantagesPage.advantagesItemContent2: Every business is unique, which is why our services are fully customizable based on your operations, industry, and the specific challenges you face.
AdvantagesPage.advantagesItemContent3: Our solutions are ISO 27001 and SOC 2 Type II certified, ensuring maximum protection of your sensitive data and compliance with information security standards.
AdvantagesPage.advantagesItemContent4: We use the latest technologies to ensure efficient and secure receivables management, keeping you at the forefront of innovation in receivables management.
AdvantagesPage.advantagesItemContent5: We integrate artificial intelligence and automation for optimized follow-ups, drastically reducing the need for personnel assigned to the task, which lowers costs while increasing efficiency.
AdvantagesPage.advantagesItemContent6: Our pricing is performance-based, meaning you only pay for the results achieved, ensuring optimal return on investment.
AdvantagesPage.advantagesItemContent7: In case of delinquent receivables, we ensure a swift handover of files to our joint venture, the law firm Maîtres du Recouvrement, for a fast and effective legal approach.
AdvantagesPage.advantagesItemContent8: We assist you in integrating our solutions with your existing systems, ensuring a smooth transition without interrupting your daily operations.
AdvantagesPage.advantagesItemContent9: We believe in a trust-based relationship with our clients, built on transparency and open communication. You benefit from regular, detailed reports and close collaboration with our managers.
AdvantagesPage.advantagesItemContent10: By transforming your receivables management into a strategic process, we help you establish a solid foundation that promotes not only sustainable growth but also the strengthening of your client relationships.
AdvantagesPage.lastAdvantagesItem: By choosing CommUnite, you benefit from comprehensive, personalized, and secure receivables management, supported by innovative technologies and specialized legal expertise, ensuring optimal results, total transparency, and guidance toward sustainable growth.

PrivacyPolicy.mainDescription: What is personal information? “Personal information is that which relates to a natural person and allows them to be identified. They are confidential. With certain exceptions, they cannot be communicated without the consent of the person concerned.”
PrivacyPolicy.description1: The protection of personal information is essential for CommUnity. We are committed to protecting the privacy and security of the personal information we collect, whether it concerns our customers or our staff. This information is managed with discretion, rigor, and in accordance with legal, regulatory, and contractual requirements.
PrivacyPolicy.description2: CommUnity pays particular attention to safeguarding the personal data it holds. Each lawyer and staff member is required to respect not only the fundamental principles of protection of personal information but also the ethical standards specific to the legal profession. Aware of the importance of professional secrecy, our firm reinforces this obligation by signing confidentiality commitments and through training.
PrivacyPolicy.description3: CommUnity fully assumes its responsibility for safeguarding the personal data in its possession. Each member of our team is committed to adhering to the standards established for the preservation of this information. In addition to adhering to the provisions of the Civil Code of Quebec concerning loyalty and confidentiality, we place emphasis on the continuing training of our staff. This results in the signing of a confidentiality agreement and regular training sessions on the subject.
PrivacyPolicy.title4: Management of customer and employee data
PrivacyPolicy.description4: CommUnity collects personal information as part of its legal activities, whether for the provision of legal services, communication with clients, financial analysis, or recruitment and team management procedures. Our priority is to only collect the data strictly necessary to carry out our mandates. All information, regardless of its format or method of storage, benefits from rigorous protection to guarantee its confidentiality and protection.
PrivacyPolicy.title5: Retention and communication of personal information
PrivacyPolicy.description5: CommUnity implements rigorous security protocols to guarantee the confidentiality of personal information. Access to this data is strictly reserved for duly authorized members of the firm. This information is processed exclusively within the framework of the mandates for which it was provided. The firm undertakes to never share this data with external entities without the explicit consent of the client, unless a legal obligation compels us to do so.
PrivacyPolicy.description6: Everyone has the right to consult the personal data that CommUnity keeps about them. In addition, they have the right to request an update or correction of this information. To do this, any request must be addressed to the Privacy Protection Officer within the firm. This request may be accompanied by a processing fee.
PrivacyPolicy.description7: Anyone with concerns about the protection of their personal information can contact the Privacy Officer.
PrivacyPolicy.description8: CommUnity reserves the right to modify this policy at any time. Note that the latest version of our policy is displayed on this page.
